description: Source file implementing tree comparison and manipulation functions for a version control system, including scoring similarities between directory trees, matching trees, and shifting trees based on prefixes.

methods.name: int score_missing(unsigned mode)
methods.description: Calculates a score penalty based on missing file modes.

methods.name: int score_differs(unsigned mode1,unsigned mode2)
methods.description: Calculates a score penalty for differing file modes between two trees.

methods.name: int score_matches(unsigned mode1,unsigned mode2)
methods.description: Calculates a score indicating similarity between matching trees based on modes.

methods.name: void * fill_tree_desc_strict(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * hash)
methods.description: Reads a tree object from storage and initializes a tree descriptor.

methods.name: int score_trees(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2)
methods.description: Compares two tree objects and returns a score representing their similarity.

methods.name: void match_trees(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,int * best_score,char ** best_match,const char * base,int recurse_limit)
methods.description: Recursively matches subtrees to find the best match score.

methods.name: int splice_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid1,const char * prefix,const struct object_id * oid2,struct object_id * result)
methods.description: Replaces a subtree in a tree at a given prefix with another subtree.

methods.name: void shift_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,struct object_id * shifted,int depth_limit)
methods.description: Shifts a tree by prefixing or removing subdirectories to match another tree.

methods.name: void shift_tree_by(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,struct object_id * shifted,const char * shift_prefix)
methods.description: Shifts a tree by adding or removing a specified prefix to align two trees.
